% Pattern: restate/thm-restate/article. One theorem printed twice. The
% restatement keeps its own tag (AX3.7), and the proof after it proves the
% first print too.
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here
% want restate-1 statement/theorem 1 origin=restated
% want proof-1 proof - proves=restate-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm,thm-restate}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\begin{restatable}{theorem}{mainthm}
Every bounded monotone sequence converges.
\end{restatable}
\section{Proof}
\mainthm*
\begin{proof}
Take the supremum.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
